purpose: Compositional research routes for a source or whole conversation; choose ALL relevant routes. This is a routing policy, not a prediction classifier.

routes.description: A source document, keynote, press release, filing, PDF, video or dataset
routes.min_evidence: Original publisher, date, URL, license/access, digest or version, exact evidence locator

routes.description: A quote, statement, assertion, reported number or vendor benchmark
routes.min_evidence: Speaker/publisher, what was claimed, date, source locator, qualifier, claim class and verification status
routes.caution: Claims are not by default observations

routes.description: A numerical fact or reproducible observation with fixed metric population
routes.min_evidence: Metric, unit, time, population/denominator, observed/estimated, source and method

routes.description: A series of comparable quarterly/annual numerical observations
routes.min_evidence: Stable population, exact time scope, series ID, method/version and source IDs

routes.description: Hardware, software, OS, ISA or API feature, capability or compatibility
routes.min_evidence: Exact product version, availability status, platform, specification source
routes.caution: Distinguish announced, preview, shipping and measured

routes.min_evidence: Hardware/config, code/workload, sample size, duration, baseline, success, method, confidence

routes.description: TAM, growth, ASP, unit or capacity projections by management/analysts
routes.min_evidence: Publisher, issue date, target date, market definition, value, qualifier, scenario label
routes.caution: New vintage, never overwrite old estimate

routes.description: Our own user-adjustable calculations and stress cases
routes.min_evidence: Inputs, units, sensitivity range, formula, unknowns, scope, model date

routes.description: New company, product, standards body, buyer, channel, workload or architecture
routes.min_evidence: Entity type, canonical name, aliases, sources, stable ID, scope
routes.caution: Avoid duplicate aliases; never infer ownership

routes.description: Customer/supplier, competition, interoperability, ownership, coalition, platform dependence
routes.min_evidence: Subject, relation, object, date, evidence, announced vs executed, status
routes.caution: Membership not equivalent to product deployment

routes.description: Earnings, product launch, financing, deployment commitment, supply update
routes.min_evidence: Entity, event date, reported status, scope, evidence, consequences

routes.description: End-buyer/ODM/OEM purchase signals and procurement route
routes.min_evidence: Hardware owner vs operator vs service consumer, vendor, channel, unit and denominator

routes.description: Management intent, roadmap orientation, product positioning or demand thesis
routes.min_evidence: Actor, concrete action/statement, timing, direction, evidence, alternate reading
Spec vs software implementation vs product shipping vs adoption stage
routes.caution: Draft spec does not imply shipping silicon

routes.description: An explanatory theory with uncertain causal mechanism
routes.min_evidence: Claim, why it matters, alternate hypotheses, proof and falsification metrics

routes.description: An unresolved question or high-value missing evidence
routes.min_evidence: What missing, expected decision impact, how obtainable, priority, affected domains
routes.caution: Preserve missing evidence and next test

routes.description: Differing comparable claims, denominator conflicts or revisions
routes.min_evidence: Refs for both sides, comparison basis, open vs resolved vs noncomparable
routes.caution: No silent cherry-picking of preferred value

routes.description: Data derivation, benchmark protocol, market model or analytical equation
routes.min_evidence: Inputs, calculation, boundary conditions, reproducibility, version, output target
routes.caution: Must not invent synthetic data as observed

routes.description: New UI/UX/research automation feature or data workflow
routes.min_evidence: User outcome, linked domain evidence, acceptance criteria, implementer issue
routes.caution: An idea is not a factual source

examples.input: Lisa Su / AMD Advancing AI keynote
examples.avoid: Do not publish raw transcript or call vendor forecasts observed.

examples.input: Microsoft Windows agentic launch + Docker sandbox talk
examples.avoid: Do not treat a demo as measured cloud TAM.

examples.input: New AMD Intel x86 unit-share report

examples.avoid: One research packet can have many relevant routes.
